import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from kt import *

FAIL = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAIL.append(name)
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("  got ", json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True))
        print("  want", json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True))
    else:
        print("ok  ", name)

def campaign(types, modules, runs, calls=None, pipes=None, entries=None, machine=None):
    return {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": calls or [],
            "pipes": pipes or [], "entries": entries or ["main"],
            "machine": machine, "runs": runs}

types = [{"name": "St", "kind": "enum", "values": ["S0", "S1", "S2"]},
         {"name": "Msg", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4},
         {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"}]
mods = [{"name": "main", "params": [["st", "St"], ["msg", "Msg"]],
         "result": ["r", "Flag"], "requires": None}]
machine = {"states": ["S0", "S1", "S2"], "initial": "S0",
           "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
           "transitions": [
               {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "go", "cost": 3, "when": None},
               {"from": "S1", "to": "S2", "command": "next", "cost": 5, "when": None}]}

def strun(state, message, result=0):
    objects = [("x0", u(state, 4))]
    text = (message + "\x00" * 4).encode('latin-1')[:4]
    for i in range(4):
        objects.append(("x%d" % (2 + i), text[i:i+1]))
    objects.append(("x6", bytes([result])))
    return {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest(objects)}

runs = [strun(0, "hi"), strun(1, "hi"), strun(2, "hi")]
out = run(campaign(types, mods, runs, machine=machine))
check("state plan slots", out['plans'][0]['slots'],
      [["x0", ["st"], 4], ["x2", ["msg", 0], 1], ["x3", ["msg", 1], 1],
       ["x4", ["msg", 2], 1], ["x5", ["msg", 3], 1], ["x6", ["r"], 1]])
check("state corpus", [(c['commands'], c['cost']) for c in out['corpus']],
      [(["hi"], 0), (["go", "hi"], 3), (["go", "next", "hi"], 8)])
check("state records", [r['status'] for r in out['records']], ["READY"] * 3)

# unreachable state
machine2 = {"states": ["S0", "S1", "S2"], "initial": "S0",
            "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
            "transitions": [
                {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "go", "cost": 3, "when": None},
                {"from": "S1", "to": "S1", "command": "loop", "cost": 1, "when": None}]}
out = run(campaign(types, mods, [strun(2, "hi"), strun(1, "hi")], machine=machine2))
check("unreachable", [r['status'] for r in out['records']], ["UNREACHABLE", "READY"])
check("unreachable corpus", len(out['corpus']), 1)

# guarded transition: the guard sees the recovered desired state
machine3 = {"states": ["S0", "S1", "S2"], "initial": "S0",
            "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
            "transitions": [
                {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "go", "cost": 3,
                 "when": ["eq", ["var", "st"], ["const", "St", "S1"]]},
                {"from": "S0", "to": "S2", "command": "jump", "cost": 7, "when": None},
                {"from": "S1", "to": "S2", "command": "next", "cost": 5, "when": None}]}
out = run(campaign(types, mods, [strun(1, "hi"), strun(2, "hi")], machine=machine3))
check("guarded prep", [(c['commands'], c['cost']) for c in out['corpus']],
      [(["go", "hi"], 3), (["jump", "hi"], 7)])

# lexicographic tie break and command count tie break
machine4 = {"states": ["S0", "S1", "S2"], "initial": "S0",
            "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
            "transitions": [
                {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "b", "cost": 2, "when": None},
                {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "a", "cost": 2, "when": None},
                {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "z", "cost": 2, "when": None},
                {"from": "S1", "to": "S2", "command": "n", "cost": 1, "when": None}]}
out = run(campaign(types, mods, [strun(2, "hi")], machine=machine4))
check("lexicographic tie", out['corpus'][0]['commands'], ["a", "n", "hi"])
check("lexicographic cost", out['corpus'][0]['cost'], 3)

# cheaper but longer path wins on cost first
machine5 = {"states": ["S0", "S1", "S2"], "initial": "S0",
            "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
            "transitions": [
                {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "direct", "cost": 4, "when": None},
                {"from": "S0", "to": "S0", "command": "detour", "cost": 1, "when": None},
                {"from": "S0", "to": "S2", "command": "end", "cost": 5, "when": None}]}
out = run(campaign(types, mods, [strun(2, "hi")], machine=machine5))
check("cost beats length", out['corpus'][0]['commands'], ["direct", "hi"])
check("cost beats length value", out['corpus'][0]['cost'], 4)

# cyclic machine
machine6 = {"states": ["S0", "S1"], "initial": "S0",
            "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
            "transitions": [
                {"from": "S0", "to": "S1", "command": "go", "cost": 1, "when": None},
                {"from": "S1", "to": "S0", "command": "back", "cost": 1, "when": None}]}
out = run(campaign(types, mods, [strun(1, "hi")], machine=machine6))
check("cyclic", out['corpus'][0]['commands'], ["go", "hi"])

print()
print("FAILURES:", FAIL if FAIL else "none")
PYEOF
